ui.chat.user_turn.show_more.role: Button beneath the user message prose inside its bubble.
ui.chat.user_turn.show_more.tone: Short action label, sentence case, no punctuation.
ui.chat.user_turn.show_more.note: Expand the clipped long message to reveal all its existing text; does not load additional records.

ui.chat.user_turn.show_less.role: Button beneath the user message prose inside its bubble.
ui.chat.user_turn.show_less.tone: Short action label, sentence case, no punctuation.
ui.chat.user_turn.show_less.note: Collapse the expanded message back to its 174px excerpt; never delete or hide the entire message.

ui.chat.user_turn.stamp.sent.role: accessible name and tooltip-adjacent label of the time stamp under a message the user sent
ui.chat.user_turn.stamp.sent.tone: past-tense phrase followed by a date and time, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.user_turn.stamp.sent.length: Short; the date placeholder carries most of the width.
ui.chat.user_turn.stamp.sent.note: Screen-reader label for a visible bare time such as '3:42 PM'. The date placeholder is already localised (day, month, year and time) and its order is the language's own, so place it where the language reads naturally.

placeholders.date: the localised full date and time of the event, already formatted for this language
